Q: Firebase Login Assertion failed: new_time >= loop->time, file c:\ws\deps\uv\src\win\core.c, line 309 A:

I'm running Windows 11 with VirtualBox 7.1.4. One day, every npm command suddenly started throwing an error. I tried many things to fix it but had no luck.

I then created a new virtual machine instance, and the same error appeared for npm commands. That's when I realized the issue might be with VirtualBox itself.

Finally, I upgraded VirtualBox from 7.1.4 to 7.2.8, and that fixed the issue.

Q: Complex numbers in Python A:

In Python, you can put ‘j’ or ‘J’ after a number to make it imaginary, so you can write complex literals easily:

>>> 1j
1j

>>> 1J
1j

>>> 1j * 1j
(-1+0j)

The ‘j’ suffix comes from electrical engineering, where the variable ‘i’ is usually used for current. (The reasoning found here.)

The type of a complex number is complex, and you can use the type as a constructor if you prefer:

>>> complex(2, 3)
(2+3j)

A complex number has some built-in accessors:

>>> z = 2 + 3j
>>> z.real
2.0

>>> z.imag
3.0

>>> z.conjugate()
(2-3j)

Several built-in functions support complex numbers:

>>> abs(3 + 4j)
5.0

>>> pow(3 + 4j, 2)
(-7+24j)

The standard module cmath has more functions that handle complex numbers:

>>> import cmath
>>> cmath.sin(2 + 3j)
(9.15449914691143-4.168906959966565j)

Q: How to programmatically implement nested JSON-LD Schema for a biography database in WordPress? A:

It’s not clear from your question whether your problem is

  • actually generating the JSON-LD, or
  • making your code to do so more efficient.

If it’s the former, there are a couple of php libraries you can use.

If it’s the latter, you can consider using WordPress transients as a memoization cache for the generated objects. That way the generation code will run less often.
